events.fact: Calendly OAuth apps are created via Developer tools at calendly.com/app/developer (or developer.calendly.com/login if the account is still being migrated), under the OAuth apps tab by selecting Create OAuth app.
Creating a Calendly OAuth app requires specifying App name, Redirect URI, Environment type (Sandbox or Production), and selecting at least one scope.
Calendly OAuth creation is self-serve with no documented app review or approval gate before arbitrary users can authorize it.
Sandbox redirect URIs allow https URIs and http URIs on localhost (e.g. http://localhost:1234/callback). Production requires https URIs only.
Composio's redirect URI for Calendly is https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback.
Client ID, client secret, and webhook signing key are shown once upon creation and cannot be retrieved again; they must be copied immediately.
Calendly OAuth 2.1 requires Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) with the S256 method (code_challenge_method=S256).
Calendly does not let end users selectively approve individual scopes during the OAuth connection flow; the scopes configured in the OAuth app are requested as a fixed set.
